description: Set environment variables for an app. Use when percher_publish reports missing env vars, or when the user needs to configure secrets like API keys. Pass values as { key: value } pairs. Optional scope: 'all' (default) applies to the live app and every preview, while 'live'/'preview' apply only to that deploy type and override the 'all' value there.

scope.description: Env scope: 'all' (default) applies to the live app and every preview; 'preview' applies only to preview deploys and overrides 'all' there; 'live' applies only to the live app and overrides 'all' there.

name: percher_env_set
